annotations.title: Live planning constraints for an electrical job postcode

description: Looks up, live from official open data, what applies at the customer's postcode before solar PV, battery, EV charger, external cabling, rewire or consumer unit work: listed buildings, conservation areas, Article 4 directions, World Heritage Sites, National Landscapes, scheduled monuments and flood risk zones (planning.data.gov.uk, England, councils that publish). Returns each constraint found with its source link, what it means for the electrical work (listed building consent, solar on a wall facing a road, flood resilient wiring), the council and nation, and the matching check_part_p nation. A constraint not found is not proof of none: the answer says so. Example: {"postcode":"BA1 2LR"}.
name: property_check
title: Live planning constraints for an electrical job postcode
